answer: Witness-garden quorum. Each new identity must be seeded by a distinct existing member who claims it in a shared garden log; a claim only matures if a random echo set of prior claimants reconfirms it over several epochs. Duplicate claims collapse to the earliest sparrow-tagged entry, so a sybil cluster must recruit many independent, already-mature claimants. Cost: sustained attention from N distinct members per identity, not money.
